content.title: ESG Performance, Corporate Profitability, and Capital Market Trust: Evidence From Chinese A‐Share Firms
content.abstract: ABSTRACT This study examines the associations between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, corporate financial performance, and capital market trust among 1353 Chinese A‐share listed firms over 2010–2023. Drawing on stakeholder, information asymmetry, and signaling theories, capital market trust is operationalized through a composite measure combining analyst coverage, institutional ownership, and absolute analyst forecast error. Baseline estimates show that ESG performance is positively associated with corporate profitability and the composite capital market trust measure.
